auth.form.label: Sign in
auth.form.title: Sign in to buy tickets
auth.form.intro: Enter your email and we'll send you a sign-in link. No password needed.
auth.form.email.label: Email
auth.signedOut.notice: You've signed out of this browser.
auth.signedOut.label: Signed out
auth.sessionOver.label: Session ended
auth.sessionOver.notice: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue; the page you were on will reopen.
auth.sent.label: Sent
auth.sent.title: Check your inbox
auth.sent.body: If the address is valid, a sign-in link has been sent to {email}.
auth.sent.hint: The link works once and expires after 15 minutes. If you request several, only the newest works.
auth.throttled.title: You've asked too many times
auth.throttled.body: Each email gets at most 3 links per 15 minutes. Use the newest link in your inbox, or try again later.
auth.verifying.label: Signing in
auth.verifying.title: Checking your link
auth.verifying.body: This takes a second. You'll go back to the page you were on.
auth.invalid.label: Couldn't sign in
auth.invalid.title: This link no longer works
auth.invalid.body: This link has expired or was already used. Get a new one.
auth.after.label: After you sign in
auth.after.seats: You'll go back to picking seats for {event}. Your selection is remembered.
auth.after.tickets: Tickets you've bought stay on My tickets.
auth.after.page: You'll go back to the page you were on.
